layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant mid-day view of a high-energy alluvial plain
features: Vast, open 'fern-savanna' stretching to the horizon
Braided river channels with coarse gravel and sand bars
Waist-high thickets of hardy ferns and club mosses
Strong, direct sunlight creating high-contrast shadows
Scattered, wind-swept conifers standing alone in the distance
No grass; ground is a textured carpet of ancient spore-plants
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic, wide-angle landscape of an expansive, sun-drenched plain. The ground is a sea of green ferns under a massive, clear blue sky.

visuals.ground: Coarse sand and gravel substrate covered in a dense, uniform layer of low-growing ferns and lycophytes. No grass. Soil is well-drained and pale.
visuals.sky: Bright, saturated blue with high visibility and a brilliant noon sun.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Sandy loam, rounded river cobbles, and dense fern-mats.
